Bug_Title: UMAC: Uncallable method defined in anonymous class (UMAC_UNCALLABLE_METHOD_OF_ANONYMOUS_CLASS)
Bug_Details:
This anonymous class defines a method that is not directly invoked and does not override
a method in a superclass. Since methods in other classes cannot directly invoke methods
declared in an anonymous class, it seems that this method is uncallable. The method
might simply be dead code, but it is also possible that the method is intended to
override a method declared in a superclass, and due to a typo or other error the method does not,
in fact, override the method it is intended to.
Bug_Explanation: The 'executeTask' method is defined inside an anonymous Runnable class but is not called or overridden anywhere. It's a dead code that will not have any effect on the program.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case called the showBug method, which contains an anonymous Runnable class with an uncallable method named executeTask. The test case will fail to compile as the executeTask method is not called or overridden.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the test passed successfully without any compilation errors. This indicates that the executeTask method is not called or overridden in the test code, but it does not mean that the method is uncallable. The method might be intended for use in other parts of the codebase, and its absence in the test does not necessarily indicate a bug.
